Bipartisan opposition to Trump's war in Iran is growing, and fast.

Today, House Republicans helped pass a resolution to end the war.

Two weeks ago, the Senate did the same on a resolution I cosponsored with @SenTimKaine and other colleagues. In the week ahead, the Senate has another vote to require congressional approval or end the war. 

It's long past time did so.


Marianna Sotomayor (@MariannaReports)

Our military and our national security suffer from his special brand of malign incompetence.

But this corrupt act of self-dealing will never withstand legal scrutiny. Hopefully the court will strike it down. If not, a future IRS must refuse to honor this sham agreement.

But Trump promised to do anything for Big Oil and now they are cashing in.

Don’t let them fool you — this is not about bringing prices down. This is about exporting more oil to other countries even as they risk our coastline to do it.


James Bikales (@jamepdx)

His most fact-challenged claim: It’s Over!

And if it’s really over, how come our troops aren’t on the way home?
